authority.rule: GitHub implements machine-readable contracts and runtime consumers; Drive owner canon remains controlling for programme intent.

zones.allowed_infrastructure: minimal reversible/safety/ecological/access/service infrastructure only when evidence and approvals permit

zones.secondary_facility_policy: preferred band for compatible secondary buildings/facilities where ecology, safety, planning and site evidence permit

invariants: 1000 m is a separate managed ecological corridor width
11000 m is the derived outer envelope, not an exclusion radius
site-specific QRA, ecology, cultural, planning and regulatory evidence may impose stricter geometry

build_lifecycle.permanent_facility_pattern: site/facility parent -> building child -> room/module -> assembly/part

demountables.role: temporary enabling accommodation/support assets during staged foundations and permanent-building construction
demountables.mobility: relocate around site as construction horizons advance
demountables.forbidden_shortcut: do not relabel a demountable into a higher-hazard laboratory without new fit-out, classification and acceptance

mission_3_additional_callable_units.source_rule: build when test outcomes plus costed/expected excess material and manufacturing capacity justify it
mission_3_additional_callable_units.callable_rule: role assignment may change only after readiness/configuration evidence; reserve status does not prove mission or deflection capability

fleet_policy.post_m16: scale dynamically from observed mission cadence, turnaround, failures, repair demand, node bandwidth and redundancy need

living_support.housing: self-contained role-linked onsite accommodation by default
living_support.food_and_housing_benefit: intended free or subsidised according to future lawful operating/benefit structure

community_contribution.purpose: paid socialisation, cross-discipline community formation, stewardship and enjoyable non-core-work contribution
community_contribution.family_and_resident_access: activities may be open to residents/families and others in the community subject to capacity/safety
community_contribution.capacity_rule: available activities grow with population, skills, demand, organisers and operating capacity

credit_model.ledger: track approved paid community contribution separately from core-role hours
candidate_settlement: cash-out/settlement on moving or leaving where lawfully structured
credit_model.rule: no unpaid compulsory upkeep and no automatic conversion into employment terms

per_user_instance.rule: renaming the user-facing companion does not change the underlying platform identity or authority

universal_avatar.canonical_rule: store normalized avatar/profile metadata and provider references in .CGX; do not copy provider credentials
universal_avatar.sync_scope: explicit opt-in per provider, per field and per direction

privacy_security: connected account does not imply permission to publish or write back
private employment/housing data is not exposed to community views by default
profile/avatar/image rights and provider terms must be respected
identity resolution and retention are explicit user-controlled policies

lightspeed_surfaces.principle: one profile/OKR graph feeds work, life and optional community views without duplicating canonical identity
lightspeed_surfaces.maturity: contract defined; full runtime/UI/provider-sync implementation remains future work

cross_domain_bridges: Romer.cgx/InterSol facility and workforce state -> Eco.cgx/restoration and corridor evidence
Romer.cgx/community opportunities -> LS.cgx/Quest, OKR and calendar surfaces
LS.cgx/personal SAI profile receipt -> Cognigrex identity/preferences without becoming employment or site authority
evidence_boundaries: reference site is not land or approval authority
planning geometry is not regulatory/QRA proof
community hours and benefits are not current employment terms
universal avatar sync is not implemented merely because this contract exists
reserve units are not flight-ready or emergency-ready without independent evidence
